query_text: Create a phone tool that just strips out all the extra spaces and weird invisible characters from text I paste in, because I keep copying stuff from PDFs or group chats and it always has garbage spacing that messes up my documents when I paste it somewhere else and I have to manually clean it up every single time, which is such a waste of time, so I want something where I just dump the text in and hit a button and it comes out clean.

Make a phone tool for reformatting paragraphs where I can set my own line length so the text wraps exactly how I want it, because every time I copy text from somewhere it comes in with random line breaks in the wrong spots and I have to fix it by hand before I can use it anywhere, and it drives me crazy especially when I am dealing with long articles or reports that I need to paste into other places.

Create a phone tool that counts syllables in whatever words or lines I type in and then tells me if what I wrote actually works as a haiku, because I keep trying to write them for fun or for class but I always lose count halfway through and end up with the wrong number of syllables without realizing it until someone points it out, so I want something on my phone that just checks it for me instantly.

Need a rhyme finder tool on my phone for when I am trying to write song lyrics and I get totally stuck on a line because I cannot think of anything that rhymes with the word I want to use, it kills the whole flow and I end up sitting there for ages trying to think of something, so I just want to type in a word and get a list of words that rhyme with it so I can pick one that fits and keep going.

Make a quick converter tool on my phone that handles Roman numerals and regular numbers both ways, because I keep running into Roman numerals in books, movie titles, and old documents and I always have to stop and try to work it out in my head or search for a calculator, which is annoying when I just want to know what number it actually is without doing mental math every single time.

Create a phone tool where I can look up any emoji and find out what it actually means and what its code is, because half the time I get emojis from people and I genuinely do not know what they are trying to say and I also sometimes need the code to paste an emoji into a form that does not have a keyboard picker, so I want to be able to search by name or paste the emoji itself and get all that info right there.

Create a text case converter tool for my phone that can switch whatever I type or paste between all caps, all lowercase, and title case in one tap, because I constantly get text in the wrong case from copy-pasting things and retyping everything just to fix the capitalization is a huge hassle, especially when it is a long piece of text, so I just want to paste it in, tap which style I want, and have it done immediately.

Need a fun little generator on my phone that makes up sci-fi alien species names and planet names, like I am always working on little story ideas and world-building stuff and I spend way too long trying to come up with names that sound properly alien and not just like random gibberish, so I want something where I just tap a button and it spits out a species name and a planet name together so I can grab whatever sounds cool and use it.

Make a phone app that throws random hobby challenges at me for the weekend, because I always end up doing the same things or just scrolling my phone when I have free time and I want something to push me to try something different, so I want to open it up and have it suggest a fun little challenge to try like learn a new skill or make something or go somewhere, something I actually would not have thought of on my own.

Create a startup name idea generator for my phone that I can use when I am brainstorming business ideas, because coming up with a name that sounds catchy and original is honestly one of the hardest parts and I end up going in circles, so I want something where I can tap a button and get a bunch of name ideas I can play with and riff off of, even if they are a bit silly sometimes it helps get the creative side going.

Create a phone tool that randomly picks a neighbourhood or area of a city for me to explore and gives me a little prompt about what to go check out there, because I live somewhere with tons of interesting spots but I always default to the same familiar areas and never branch out, so I want something that will just tell me where to go this time and give me a reason to actually walk around somewhere new instead of staying in my comfort zone.

A random emoji art generator on your phone where you tap once and it mashes together a bunch of emojis into a little combination that kind of looks like a scene or a character, something silly and shareable that changes every time you tap, with a way to save or copy whichever one you like so you can send it to friends or use it somewhere.

Build a phone app that randomly pairs up two star signs and gives a little note about how compatible they are supposed to be, because my friends and I are always joking about astrology stuff and checking compatibility and it would be fun to have something on my phone where I just hit a button and it picks two random signs and tells us if they are a great match or a total disaster, just for laughs.

Build a little phone app that suggests random acts of kindness I can actually do, because sometimes I want to do something nice for someone but my brain goes completely blank and I just end up doing nothing, so I want to tap a button and get a real suggestion that I can actually pull off today without any big preparation, something small and doable that would genuinely make someone happy.

A random film and documentary picker you can use on your phone when you sit down to watch something and cannot decide what to put on, where it just gives you one suggestion at a time with a short description so you can say yes or skip it and get another one, covering all kinds of genres so you might actually end up watching something you would never have searched for yourself.

Create a weekend adventure randomizer on my phone that gives me a full little plan for what to do, because every Friday I ask myself what I want to do that weekend and I draw a total blank and then nothing happens and the weekend is wasted, so I want something that will just decide for me and give me an activity, an outing idea, or something creative to try so I actually have a plan to look forward to.

Need a phone app that picks a random word from a different language every day and shows me what it means and how to say it, because I am always curious about other languages but never know where to start and I thought it would be a fun low-effort way to pick up interesting words over time, so I want something that just gives me one interesting word a day from languages around the world and keeps it light and easy.

Create a phone app with a spin wheel that picks what to have for dinner tonight, because me and whoever I am eating with go back and forth forever about what to eat and nobody can ever just decide, so I want to put a bunch of meal options on the wheel and just spin it to settle it once and for all, and I want to be able to add or remove options from the wheel so it reflects what we actually feel like eating.

Build a phone tool that lets me add extra time to a running countdown when I am in the middle of a timed quiz or task and I need just a little more time to finish, because I always run out of time on timed things and it is so stressful when the clock hits zero before I have finished and I lose my progress, so I want a timer on my phone where I can tap a button to extend it by a few minutes without having to stop and reset everything.

Create a phone tool that always shows text labels next to icons so I never have to guess what a button does, because I get so frustrated when apps just show a little symbol and expect me to know what it means, half the time I have no idea if I am pressing the right thing and I end up tapping the wrong stuff, so I want something where every icon clearly says what it is right underneath it and that label never disappears.

A content filter tool on your phone that you can set up to automatically blur or hide anything that might be upsetting or overstimulating before you see it, like you type in the kinds of things that bother you and from then on anything matching those gets hidden behind a tap-to-reveal cover so you stay in control of what you see, useful for people who need to browse without getting blindsided by distressing content.

Make a phone tool with a toggle that rewrites complicated text into simpler everyday language when I turn it on, because I run into walls of confusing official or technical writing all the time and I just want to understand what it is actually saying without having to read it five times, so I want to paste something in, flip the toggle, and get a version that sounds like a normal person wrote it.

Need a phone tool that lets me set up a quick emergency shortcut so I can reach someone or send a message for help as fast as possible without having to unlock my phone and find a contact and type everything out, because in a real scary moment every second matters and I want something I can set up in advance and then trigger super fast when I actually need it.

Build a phone communication tool with a board of picture symbols that predicts what I might want to say next based on what I just picked, for people who have trouble speaking and need to express themselves quickly on their phone, so I want the symbols to be big and easy to tap and the board to get smarter about the kinds of things I say often so I do not have to hunt around for the right symbol every single time.

Build a phone tool that helps cut down on harsh or sudden sounds for people who are sensitive to loud noise, where I can set how much filtering I want and it gives me a calmer listening experience, because sudden loud noises are really overwhelming and I want something I can turn on when I need a quieter environment without having to completely block out all sound around me.

Create a phone tool that looks at a photo I upload and writes a short description of what is in it so I never have to type those out myself. I always skip that step when posting because it takes too long, but I know I should do it. Just let me tap a photo, get a description I can copy, and move on. Nothing fancy needed, just something that actually works on my phone.

A small phone app where you can turn off mouse-style clicking entirely and get around using only the keyboard keys, so everything is reachable without lifting your hands. I keep having to switch back and forth and it wastes so much time. The app should show you what key does what, let you move through things in order, and make it obvious where you are at any moment.

Need a phone tool that marks the different sections of whatever page you are on so you always know which part you are looking at, like a little indicator that says you are in the navigation area or the main content or the footer. I always get lost scrolling and have to backtrack. Something that quietly shows the region labels without getting in the way would save me a lot of hassle.

Build a phone app that reads whatever is on the screen out loud as soon as it changes, so I do not have to manually trigger anything or tap around to hear what happened. I hate having to go looking for the new content after something loads. It should just narrate things as they appear, with a volume slider and a way to pause if I need quiet, and that is really all I need.

Make a stopwatch app for my phone that can record individual laps and splits while still running, so I can see each interval time right there on the screen without stopping. I do interval training sometimes and I want to see how each round compares. It would also be great if I could save a session and export it somehow, maybe as a simple list I can share or look back at later.

Create a pedometer app for my phone that counts my steps on its own throughout the day and also lets me mark laps so I can see the distance for each stretch separately. I go for walks in chunks and I always want to know how far each chunk was. I would love to see total distance for the day too, and maybe a simple history so I can check back on how I did this week.

Build a colour picker app for my phone where I can point the camera at anything and tap to grab the exact colour from that spot. I am always trying to match colours for little craft projects and I end up just guessing. The app should show me the colour code or the name after I pick it, and let me save a few colours together so I can look at them side by side.

Make a phone app that shows me the full alphabet for a writing system I am trying to learn, like all the characters laid out in order with their sounds written next to them so I can see the whole thing at once. I keep forgetting which letter sounds like what when I am reading. Tapping a letter should show me more detail or play the sound, and I want to be able to flip through at my own pace.

Build a blood pressure log app for my phone that lets me type in my readings each time I check and then shows them in a simple chart so I can spot any patterns over time. I check pretty regularly but I keep losing track of the numbers in my notes app. I want to see the date and time next to each reading, and a little graph that shows whether things are going up or down.

Build a timer app for my phone that can run several countdowns at the same time, each one with its own label so I know what each one is for. I cook a lot and I always have multiple things going at once and my current phone timer only does one at a time. Each timer should ring or buzz separately when it hits zero and I should be able to add or remove them without stopping the others.

Need a breath-hold training timer app for my phone that guides me through the rounds and rest periods, shows how long I have held each time, and keeps a record of my best holds. I practice breath-holding for free diving and right now I just stare at a clock which is not great. Something that walks me through the cycle automatically and logs my progress would make training way easier.

A phone app where you shake it and it randomly picks one action from a list you set up beforehand, so you never have to decide what to do next. I made a little list of stretch routines I want to try but I always end up doing the same one because choosing is annoying. The list should be easy to edit right on the phone, and the random pick should be shown big and clear so it is easy to read.

Make a phone companion app for when you are presenting on a bigger screen, so you can see your notes and control what slide is shown without walking back to the computer each time. I do small talks at meetups and I always end up hovering near my laptop. The phone should show me what is coming next and let me tap to move forward or back, just something simple that keeps me free to move around.

Need a star map app for my phone that uses the camera to show me what stars and planets I am pointing at right now, overlaid on the live view so it feels like I am looking through a window into space. I always look up at night and have no idea what anything is. Just point, see the names, maybe tap on something to get a few facts about it. I want to actually learn what I am looking at.

Make a parking spot saver app for my phone where I can tap one button when I park and it drops a pin right where I am, so I can find my way back without stress later. I park in big lots or unfamiliar streets all the time and I end up wandering around looking for my car. It should show the saved spot on a map so I can walk toward it, and let me clear it once I find the car.

Create a flashcard app for my phone that covers math theorems and their proofs, where each card shows the theorem name and statement on one side and the proof steps on the other so I can quiz myself anywhere. I want to be able to mark the ones I find hard so I review those more, and also filter by topic like geometry or algebra so I can focus on one area at a time when I study.

Build a phone flashcard app for SAT reading vocabulary where each word is shown inside a real sentence from a passage so I actually understand how it gets used, not just the definition alone. I want to flip the card to see the meaning and part of speech, and mark words as learned or still working on them. Being able to sort by difficulty or by word list would help me stay organized during prep.

Create a Bible verse memorization app for my phone where I can save verses I want to learn and tag them by theme, like faith, patience, or gratitude, so I can pull up a group when I want to focus on one topic. Each card should show the verse text and the reference, and I want a way to quiz myself where some words are hidden and I have to fill them in from memory.

Anatomy labeling cards on my phone where each card shows a part of the body and I have to name it, with a simple diagram or outline so I know which area is being asked about. I am studying for a health class and I keep mixing up names for bones and muscles. I want to go through them in order or shuffle them, and see a score at the end so I know how I am doing.

Create a financial terms flashcard app for my phone where I can flip through cards with terms on one side and plain-language definitions on the other, so I can actually understand what people mean when they talk about money stuff. I want to sort cards into categories like investing or banking, mark the ones I keep forgetting, and quiz myself on just that marked set until I get them right.

Create a geography flashcard app for my phone with cards for major rivers and mountain ranges, showing the name and where it is located, so I can learn them properly before my exam. I want to be able to flip the card to see the answer and then mark it as right or wrong so the app tracks which ones I still need to practice. Grouping by continent would help a lot for studying by region.

Literary device cards for my phone where each card names a device like metaphor or foreshadowing on one side and gives a clear definition plus a short example from real writing on the other, so I can actually remember what each one means. I want to filter by type, mark the ones I mix up, and review just those until I have them down. A simple quiz mode at the end of each session would be perfect.

Make a flashcard app for my phone that covers ISO country codes, with the two-letter code on one side and the country name on the other, so I can practice flipping through them whenever I have a spare moment. I deal with these codes at work and I keep having to look them up. I want to mark which ones I always get wrong and have a way to drill just those until I stop making mistakes.

Need a phone app for learning the NATO phonetic alphabet, with a card for each letter showing the word like Alpha or Bravo along with what letter it stands for, so I can flip through and quiz myself until I have them memorized. I work somewhere that uses these over the phone all the time and I still have to think too hard. Being able to shuffle the cards and track which ones I keep missing would really help.

Need a phone app full of business idioms and phrases, where each card shows the expression on one side and the meaning plus an example sentence on the other, so I can study them on the go. I keep running into phrases like touch base or move the needle in meetings and I am not always sure what they mean. I want to organize them by category and mark the ones I am still shaky on so I can revisit them.
